title_zh: 核对虚构突袭报道的证据范围

scenario.label_zh: 核对虚构报道的突袭消息和雷达记录范围
scenario.goal_zh: 区分未经证实的袭击消息与飞行记录并约定暂缓确定性标题

context_zh: 新闻核验课堂使用自编的虚构军事报道，人物与地点不存在，未涉及现实冲突或行动建议。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Davi
sentences.text: Our draft says a raid on the island airfield reportedly began before dawn.

sentences.speaker: Davi
sentences.text: One unnamed witness in the exercise. We also have a radar record showing an aircraft crossing the coast.

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: That record doesn't tell us what the aircraft did after it crossed.

sentences.speaker: Davi
sentences.text: So the headline shouldn't announce an attack as a confirmed fact.

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: Agreed. Keep the witness claim attributed, and ask for another source before we settle the headline.

sentences.speaker: Davi
sentences.text: I'll mark the headline as pending and separate the two pieces of information.
